lines.text: Aoife can also talk it through with Zilo, our voice tutor.
Umm, I'm not sure, but three plus one is four, and four plus two is six, so four sixths?
Zilo runs on advanced speech AI, tuned for children's voices and accents, so it understands the reasoning behind her words.
Good thinking, Aoife, let's look at my drawing: how many quarters are there?
It responds to what children say, never how they feel.
